patternCandidates.name: Assistive coachmark overlay (step-by-step guided tour with audio)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: First-time / low-literacy captain needs to learn each control on a screen (trip, home, onboarding)
patternCandidates.structure: Live screen > full-screen dim scrim with cut-out around ONE target element > tooltip bubble with short vernacular copy (+ audio) > floating Saathi/Captain Assist FAB; advance one element at a time
patternCandidates.variations: Trip screen (Hindi & English), Home (hamburger), Onboarding (DL camera, preview), flattened-screenshot overlays on e-rickshaw onboarding
patternCandidates.conflicts: Built with local masks + text instead of Runway Tool Tip; e-rickshaw onboarding uses flattened screenshots; "new text alignment" vs "english screens" sections duplicate the same 6 steps with different spacing (24/20px redlines)

patternCandidates.name: Floating assist entry (Rapido Saathi / Captain Assist pill)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Persistent help ingress on home, trip, navigation, payment screens
patternCandidates.structure: Pill/FAB bottom-right above content; states collapsed (icon) / expanded (label) / clicked ON (playing); animation on app open ("Tap to Play")
patternCandidates.variations: Names explored: Captain Assist, App Guide, Rapido Saathi (final), Hindi "क्या करू"; with/without collapse
patternCandidates.conflicts: Three local component sets for the same button; not in Runway (missing component)

patternCandidates.name: Tap CTA + confirmation bottom sheet for irreversible trip steps
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Trip state changes (Arrived, Start ride, Complete ride) after replacing swipe-to-confirm
patternCandidates.structure: Trip screen bottom card > full-width primary tap button > Bottom Sheet: close X, illustration, "Are you sure you want to ...?", rule copy, primary confirm + secondary
patternCandidates.variations: Arrived / Start ride (with wait timer) / Complete ride
patternCandidates.conflicts: Older frames (1041:159968, 1351:143645) still use swipe CTA (local Buttons); sheet is not the Runway Bottom Sheet instance

patternCandidates.name: Seat share OA with message box + double acceptance
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Order that needs extra understanding/consent before accept
patternCandidates.structure: Home of Orders > OA overlay > OA card (service chip, fare, route) > .OA message Box explaining order type > Accept (tap twice: second state "Accept again to confirm") + Reject
patternCandidates.variations: with info icon, with progress component, audio script annotation 6499:7518
patternCandidates.conflicts: 6445:1987/2307 show double acceptance on legacy non-Runway OA

patternCandidates.name: Order complete with earnings breakdown + quick feedback question
patternCandidates.whenToUse: End of trip: show earnings split (customer paid vs wallet) and ask one structured question
patternCandidates.structure: Internal Page Header > stamp > Estimated Earnings > km/min > split copy > question with chips (Secondary Tabs) or Yes/No > sticky Done
patternCandidates.variations: customer count 1-4; seat share yes/no; Hindi
patternCandidates.conflicts: Uses Secondary Tabs as answer chips instead of Chip component

patternCandidates.name: Wallet home + transfer
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain checks wallet balance, learns about wallet, transfers to UPI/bank
patternCandidates.structure: Internal page header (Earnings, Help) > .2 Tabs > balance card + transfers left + renew note > education carousel > Refer & Earn > transaction history; Transfer screen with deposit-to row & Radio bottom sheet

patternCandidates.name: Add payment method by QR photo or ID
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Collecting UPI details with low typing literacy
patternCandidates.structure: Upload QR photo tile > OR divider > UPI ID input with example helper > camera > preview (Click again / Use photo) > verifying spinner > account added

patternCandidates.name: Document upload with photo + number + OCR
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Onboarding docs (Aadhaar, DL, RC, number plate)
patternCandidates.structure: Internal Page Header > front/back upload tiles > number input with "Eg:" helper > sticky Submit (disabled until valid); states uploaded (Retake), OCR success (prefilled), error helper; submitting/submitted toast
patternCandidates.variations: video onboarding variant with screenshot header; WhatsApp help
patternCandidates.conflicts: Disabled button is detached "Buttons/Medium/Primary/Disabled"; label bug Driving License Number on vehicle number screens

patternCandidates.name: Single-choice list with sticky confirm
patternCandidates.structure: Internal Page Header > list rows (radio or checkbox right) > sticky Confirm disabled until selection
patternCandidates.variations: service cards with icons + checkbox icon
patternCandidates.conflicts: Service selection uses check_box icon not Runway Checkbox/Radio
